items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...John Kirby (phonetic spelling) 'biggest little band in the land.' ... Russell (in Procópe was on clarinet ... Piano was, wait a minute, piano was Billy Kyle, Buster Bailey on trumpet -- Buster Bailey on clarinet, Charlie Shavers is on trumpet and O'Neil Spencer on drums.

ctx.x: Now, let me see if I can remember the line-up, John Kirby on the string bass, Russell (in Procópe was on clarinet - alto -- I'm trying to think of the name of the piano player.
